data.name: Shiv Jirwankar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Shiv Jirwankar has made a big mark in cricket. With 53 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 46, with an average of 8.67 and a quick strike rate of 98.73. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 20 sixes and 23 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 160.5 overs, taking 77 wickets at an economy rate of 8.47. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
